channel.title: Multi-Agent on Harness Engineer
channel.description: Recent content in Multi-Agent on Harness Engineer

item.title: AutoGen
item.description: A pioneering multi-agent framework (now in maintenance mode, succeeded by Microsoft Agent Framework) with a layered Core/AgentChat/Extensions architecture, local and distributed runtimes, AutoGen Studio no-code GUI, and AutoGen Bench evaluation suite. Widely cited as a reference design for event-driven multi-agent runtimes.

item.title: Citadel
item.description: A harness for Claude Code and OpenAI Codex with isolated worktrees, multi-agent coordination, and persisted memory and campaign state.

item.title: Google Agent Development Kit (ADK)
item.description: A code-first Python toolkit for building, evaluating, and deploying agents, with a graph-based Workflow Runtime (routing, fan-out/fan-in, loops, human-in-the-loop), a Task API for agent-to-agent delegation, and a built-in eval/Web UI. A first-class runtime for inspectable multi-agent orchestration.

item.title: Harness Evolver
item.description: Claude Code plugin that autonomously evolves LLM agent harnesses using multi-agent proposers, LangSmith-backed evaluation, and git worktree isolation. Based on Meta-Harness (Lee et al., 2026).

item.title: How we built our multi-agent research system
item.description: Anthropic’s architecture write-up for a multi-agent system with separation of roles and structured coordination.

item.title: MAgIC
item.description: A benchmark measuring cognition, adaptability, rationality, and collaboration of LLMs in multi-agent systems, useful for evaluating how harnesses coordinate agent interactions and shared state.

item.title: MetaGPT: Meta Programming for A Multi-Agent Collaborative Framework
item.description: Encodes Standardized Operating Procedures into prompt sequences and an assembly-line role assignment to reduce cascading hallucinations in multi-agent systems — a concrete SOP-driven orchestration architecture.

item.title: Microsoft Agent Framework (MAF)
item.description: The enterprise-ready successor to AutoGen for building and orchestrating production multi-agent workflows in Python and .NET, with graph-based orchestration, checkpointing/durability, OpenTelemetry observability, declarative YAML agents, and A2A/MCP interoperability. Built for taking agents from prototype to production with inspectability.

item.title: TheAgentCompany
item.description: A benchmark of 175 consequential real-world professional tasks in a simulated software company (GitLab, Plane, RocketChat, ownCloud) with Docker-based task images, encrypted evaluators, and subcheckpoint scoring. Tests agents across coding, conversation, and multi-agent interaction.

item.title: UFO Desktop AgentOS
item.description: A Windows Desktop AgentOS with deep UIA/Win32/WinCOM integration and hybrid GUI+API actions, plus UFO³ Galaxy for multi-device DAG-based orchestration across Windows/Linux/Android via a WebSocket AIP protocol. A production-grade reference for OS-level agent harnesses and cross-device coordination.

item.title: Reality: The Final Eval — Andon Labs
item.description: Lukas Petersson and Axel Backlund of Andon Labs discuss Vending-Bench, Project Vend, and Andon Market: dollar-denominated, long-horizon evals that give frontier models inventory, a wallet, tools, and time. Concrete case studies of harness design and failure modes — Claude calling the FBI over a $2 fee, long-context meltdown loops, multi-agent price cartels, election manipulation, and why Slack-as-observability works for tracing agent behavior that static benchmarks miss.
